summary: BI-31E0C874 / DI-87225C71AAE4. Migration 20261114160000_work_item_presence_read_cursor adds two nullable columns to WorkItemPresence: the room read position of each participant. Additive, no default and no backfill; existing rows read as no position yet. The columns follow their row, which is deleted only with its work item.

fields.name: readCursorAt
fields.reason: createdAt of the newest room message handed to this principal. Internal: a timestamp, no message content.
fields.provenance: Written only by readUnreadRoomMessages and advanceRoomReadCursor (room-read-cursor.server.ts), forward-only.

fields.name: readCursorMessageId
fields.reason: messageId of that message, which breaks createdAt ties. Internal: an opaque id, no message content.
fields.provenance: Written with readCursorAt in the same update; both null or both set.
